role: A Map wrapper that lowercases every key on the way in and out, over an insertion-ordered LinkedHashMap; the living attribute maps key their instances by name and by description in one (BaseAttributeMap.attributesByName, ServersideAttributeMap.descriptionToAttributeInstanceMap).
scope_reason: In scope: every living entity's attribute map keys its instances by lower-cased name in one of these (BaseAttributeMap.attributesByName, ServersideAttributeMap), read when attributes are loaded from NBT.

members.name: internalMap
members.note: insertion order is registration order (EntityLivingBase maxHealth, knockbackResistance, movementSpeed; EntityLiving followRange; EntityMob attackDamage; EntityZombie spawnReinforcements), the ATTR_ enum order the attribute table keeps with each instance's registered flag

members.name: containsKey
members.note: registerAttribute's already-registered throw: each kind registers each attribute once

members.name: get
members.note: getAttributeInstanceByName over a saved Attributes entry (SharedMonsterAttributes.func_151475_a at a living's or the player's NBT load): the name lower-cased against the names, then against the descriptions (lower_equal)

members.name: put
members.note: registerAttribute's two puts (name, description): the fixed table, each instance marked registered by its kind

members.name: values
members.note: BaseAttributeMap.getAllAttributes, whose order writeBaseAttributeMapToNBT writes the Attributes list in: the registered instances in enum order (d.ents)

notes: lane/idxmisc 2026-09-27: the three NBT readers (snapshot_entities.c restore_attributes, serverreplay.c cp_restore_living, player.c nbt_speed_mod_amp) matched exact strings; they now go through attrs_index_by_name, which lower-cases both sides and falls back to the descriptions as ServersideAttributeMap does. Every name vanilla writes is its canonical one, so the recordings are unchanged (combat-mobs-s1, fresh-play-s1, village-cp-s42, golem-fight-s42, gold-g1-s42 OK). Not modelled: an NBT entry naming an attribute the kind never registered (Java's lookup gives null and skips it); vanilla only writes registered ones. The other members serve no caller. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was not_needed/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit).
